continuity_scope: Free League's Forbidden Lands first-edition Core Boxed Set, identified in Free League's 2026 third-party license as first published by Fria Ligan AB in 2018. The chosen witness includes the official Core Boxed Set/game pages, the official fifth-printing core-set errata, and the official license solely to establish core-versus-third-party boundaries. This is an emergent sandbox/hexcrawl rules source: campaigns, adventures, supplements, digital modules, novels, videogame adaptations, and home play remain separate.

coverage_rule: Terms-only emergent-fiction/hexcrawl audit. The selected core box gives players tools to create raiders and rogues, explore a mutable hex map, choose adventure sites, survive journeys, and potentially build a stronghold; it does not supply a bounded, claim-level canonical dramatic cast. No character or relationship records are made. Kin, professions, talents, strongholds, legends, monsters, artifacts, places, survival systems, and rules remain terms/dimensions. Named figures from core examples, legends, campaigns, adventures, or table play require a separate exact witness with a direct profile.
omissions: All named core examples, legends, NPCs, pre-generated adventurers, campaign figures, actual-play characters, and table-created characters, because this pass has no fixed claim-level dramatic cohort.
All kin, professions, talents, strongholds, legends, monsters, artifacts, places, survival systems, and rules as character nodes.

Raven's Purge and all other campaigns/adventure sites, Book of Beasts, The Bitter Reach, The Bloodmarch, digital/VTT modules, third-party Workshop material, novels, videogame adaptations, and home campaigns.
content_cautions: The official core framing includes cursed lands, terrible monsters, visceral combat, lethal magic, dangerous travel, hunger/thirst/exposure-style survival pressure, injuries/death, ruins, and resource scarcity. Groups should establish safety boundaries for violence, horror, deprivation, exploitation, and risk-focused play.

The accessible official product descriptions do not give claim-level detail on slavery. No slavery term, character claim, or social-historical analogy is made in this audit; if a table uses setting material involving enslavement or analogous coercion, it should obtain explicit consent and treat the topic with care rather than as a default adventure device.
Kin, cultures, spirituality, and social institutions are fictional game constructs. Do not map them one-to-one onto real peoples, ethnicities, religions, class systems, or historical societies.
uncertainties: Free League's 2026 license calls the game first edition published in 2018; the current store product page itself does not state a printing date. The exact rules witness is therefore the current Core Boxed Set with fifth-printing errata boundary, not an inferred revision history.
The fifth-printing errata document lists changes/clarifications but this terms-only audit does not reconstruct individual changed rules beyond the printing boundary.

Free League permits compatible third-party supplements under stated conditions, including that they may not replace official core rules or add attributes/skills. That permission does not make community material, campaigns, or their named figures canonical to the core pass.
evidence_basis: Free League official product, game, errata, and license material only. The Core Boxed Set identifies open-world survival play, player-made raiders/rogues, core manuals, hex exploration, travel, combat, magic, legends, and strongholds; the game page identifies sandbox/hexcrawl survival procedures; errata identifies fifth-printing updates; and the license identifies first-edition date and the third-party/core separation. No fan wiki or unofficial campaign material is used.
